questions.prompt: The Hagia Sophia was built as what kind of building?
questions.fact: It held the record for the world's largest interior space for nearly a thousand years.

questions.prompt: Which part of a comet points away from the Sun?
questions.fact: It is pushed by solar wind rather than trailing behind, so on the outbound leg it precedes the comet.

questions.prompt: Which trophy is awarded to the winner of the Premier League?
questions.fact: A second identical trophy exists so presentations can be staged simultaneously if the title is undecided on the final day.

questions.prompt: Which festival is held annually in the Nevada desert?
questions.fact: Participants are expected to remove everything they bring, leaving the site as they found it.

questions.prompt: Which country's currency is the yen?
questions.fact: It has no smaller circulating unit, having abolished the sen in 1953 to end wartime inflation accounting.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the novel All the Light We Cannot See?
questions.fact: He spent ten years on it, and its very short chapters were designed to be read in single sittings.

questions.prompt: Which language is used to query relational databases?
questions.fact: Every database vendor has its own dialect, so queries rarely move between systems unchanged.
